claims.made_by: Andy Burnham, Prime Minister of the United Kingdom
claims.quote: Great British Railways will have its home in Derby
claims.statement: Great British Railways will have its home in Derby.

claims.quote: Great British Railways will bring the railway together around one mission
claims.statement: Great British Railways will bring the railway together around one mission of better services for passengers.

claims.quote: bringing jobs, investment and opportunity to the city
claims.statement: The new Derby headquarters will bring jobs, investment and opportunity to the city.

claims.made_by: Pat McFadden, Work and Pensions Secretary
claims.quote: which is creating up to 500,000 opportunities for young people to earn or learn
claims.statement: The £2.5 billion youth employment support package is creating up to 500,000 opportunities for young people to earn or learn.

claims.made_by: Claire Ward, Mayor of the East Midlands
claims.quote: This is fantastic news for Derby
claims.statement: The announcement that Great British Railways will be based in Derby is fantastic news for the city.

claims.quote: an estimated £151 million boost to the region’s economy
claims.statement: The new headquarters is estimated to give the region's economy a £151 million boost.

facts.quote: the site of Great British Railways’ (GBR) headquarters is unveiled today (15 October 2026) in Derby
facts.statement: The site of the Great British Railways headquarters was unveiled in Derby on 15 October 2026.

facts.quote: Construction of the brand-new development in at Becketwell, a brownfield site in the heart of Derby city centre
facts.statement: The new headquarters is being built at Becketwell, a brownfield site in Derby city centre.

facts.quote: The site will accommodate up to 450 GBR staff
facts.statement: The Becketwell site will accommodate up to 450 GBR staff.

facts.quote: Up to 600 apprentices between 16 and 21 years old will enrol over the next 4 years
facts.statement: Up to 600 apprentices aged 16 to 21 will enrol over the next four years on the rail foundation apprenticeship.

facts.quote: fares frozen for the first time in 30 years
facts.statement: Fares have been frozen for the first time in 30 years.

facts.quote: 76,000 extra seats a week introduced across the network
facts.statement: 76,000 extra seats a week have been introduced across the rail network.

facts.quote: The announcement builds on the recent £1 billion investment in a new fleet of trains for the north set to be built at Alstom’s Derby site
facts.statement: A £1 billion investment in a new fleet of trains for the north is set to be built at Alstom's Derby site.

facts.quote: less than 7% of the railway’s workforce is under 25
facts.statement: Less than 7% of the railway's workforce is under 25.
